scope: First-site onboarding stability and account-scoped fast entry while preserving the v310 shared Posts/Pages editor and existing Studio sidebar authority.
notes: A stale active-site id without a user-scoped snapshot can no longer skip first-site verification for another account.
The old 15-second create failure is replaced by a soft recovery path that can find the newly created owned site when the response is delayed or lost.
The onboarding form draft remains on the device until a real site is confirmed.
A theme/locale preference update failure no longer turns a successfully created site into a failed onboarding flow.
This release does not claim extreme concurrent-login capacity; that requires measured production load testing.
